name: I&M Group PLC
source: I&M Group PLC audited results for the year ended 31 December 2025, consolidated statement of comprehensive income (Group, KShs thousands read as KES). One column per audited year; figures transcribed from the exchange announcement PDF at imbankgroup.com. | CRON 20261014B: H1 2026 column read from I and M Group Plc unaudited financial results for the period ended 30 June 2026, consolidated statement of comprehensive income and statement of financial position, group column (KShs thousands read as absolute KES). Total interest income 38,155,907; total interest expense 13,119,609; net interest income 25,036,298; total non-interest income 8,655,660; total operating income 33,691,958; total other operating expenses 20,560,444; profit before tax and exceptional items 13,131,514; share of profit of joint venture 331,800; profit after exceptional items 13,463,314; current tax 3,903,833 less deferred tax credit 610,331 gives income tax expense 3,293,502; profit after tax and exceptional items 10,169,812; profit after tax and non-controlling interest 9,305,096; basic and diluted EPS 5.35. Gates tie: total operating income less total other operating expenses equals 13,131,514, plus the joint venture share equals the printed 13,463,314, and profit before tax less income tax equals the printed 10,169,812. Interest Income follows the total interest income line and Net Finance Costs the total interest expense line, the same construction as the stored FY2025 column. Ratios are computed on the half year figures at the group balance sheet date (total equity 119,412,481 plus non-controlling interests 7,752,693; total assets 746,307,916), not annualised, matching the half year convention already used by other NSE bank files here.
source_note: Rebuilt from the audited group statement. The prior file carried four farmed periods whose FY2024 top line and net profit did not reconcile to the audited FY2024 comparative (farmed revenue 44,518,452 thousand against the audited 50,597,347 thousand), so only the two years the audited announcement prints are kept. Values are absolute KES; the audited statement is in KShs thousands. Income Tax is the net charge (current tax less deferred tax credit). Net finance costs carry the group interest expense on customer deposits and borrowings, the only finance cost line a bank reports; the panel has no separate interest expense row.
